name: UWWA World Title
epitaph: Named in the fed's own 22 May 1997 roster post, growing from two titles (World, Tag Team) on 18 May to four (adding U.S. and Regional) by 22 May, with a World Title Tournament announced for the first eight joiners. No bestowal, holder or result of any kind survives -- a third party's own account (DUWA, cited not reproduced) confirms the fed closed within a month of this posting, before any tournament or card could be run.
